comparison.objective: Dock a laptop level until both station latches click; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual wide-object transport, guide/connector alignment, even pressing, and latch engagement versus recessed tool use and feedback-driven rotary tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Laptop docked with both latches clicked and no drop/undock; no separate indexed spec or full numeric scoring rubric. Candidate requires two safe cycles but has undeclared response thresholds.
comparison.reason: Latch-and-connector docking does not test adjustable damping or iterative commissioning.
